issues.desc: Checklist smoke covers Authorization on protected verdict GET and keyless policy discovery, but it does not explicitly require the user-observable fail-closed job-status outcome: after the protected GET succeeds, authority_job_status must still report no authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone when the native gate receipt or multi-host quorum is missing. Background states this, but a checklist item or verification target should make it mechanically reviewable.
